type Box<T extends string> = { value: T };
const constraints: () => unknown = findConstraints;
const indexed: () => unknown = findIndexed;
const tuple: () => unknown = findTuple;
function findConstraints() {
  const builtin: Record<false, number> = {} as any;
  const own: Box<number> = { value: 1 };
  return [builtin, own];
}
function findIndexed() {
  const value: { x: number }['y'] = 1;
  return value;
}
function findTuple() {
  const value: [number?, string] = [1, 'valid value'];
  return value;
}
const valid: () => unknown = findValid;
function findValid() {
  const coordinate: ['start', number?] = ['start'];
  const keyed: Box<(typeof coordinate)[0]> = { value: coordinate[0] };
  return keyed;
}
